title: SC-300 Domain 1 questions (1.1, 1.2)
note: Original questions written for Delzar Certification Academy. Not from exam dumps or commercial banks; not affiliated with Microsoft.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Fabrikam's service desk must be able to reset passwords for non-administrator users. The staff must not be able to create users, delete users or manage authentication methods. Which role should you assign to follow the principle of least privilege?
choices: Helpdesk Administrator
Password Administrator
User Administrator
Authentication Administrator
questions.answer: Password Administrator
questions.explanation: Password Administrator only resets passwords for non-administrators and other Password Administrators. Helpdesk Administrator also resets passwords but adds extra permissions such as invalidating refresh tokens and managing service requests, so it grants more than needed.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Contoso plans to create custom Microsoft Entra roles for its application support team. What is the minimum Microsoft Entra ID license the tenant needs to create and assign custom roles?
choices: Microsoft Entra ID Free
Microsoft Entra Workload ID
Microsoft Entra External ID
Microsoft Entra ID P1
questions.answer: Microsoft Entra ID P1
questions.explanation: Custom Microsoft Entra roles require Microsoft Entra ID P1 (P2 also includes it). The Free edition supports only built-in roles, and Workload ID and External ID are separate products that do not license custom directory roles.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: When you assign a custom Microsoft Entra role, which scopes can the assignment use?
choices: The tenant, an administrative unit or a single application
A management group, an Azure subscription or a single resource group
The tenant, a single resource group or a single application only
An administrative unit or an Azure subscription only
questions.answer: The tenant, an administrative unit or a single application
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra role assignments are scoped to the whole tenant, an administrative unit or an individual application object. Management groups, subscriptions and resource groups are Azure RBAC scopes, which is the most common confusion.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Woodgrove Bank is building a custom Microsoft Entra role that lets support engineers add and rotate client secrets and certificates on app registrations, and nothing else. Which permission should the role include?
choices: microsoft.directory/applications/allProperties/read
microsoft.directory/servicePrincipals/create
microsoft.directory/applications/credentials/update
microsoft.directory/users/password/update
questions.answer: microsoft.directory/applications/credentials/update
questions.explanation: The credentials/update permission on applications allows adding and removing secrets and certificates on app registrations. The allProperties/read permission only reads the objects, and the other two act on service principals and users rather than app credentials.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: External auditors at Tailspin Toys must be able to view Microsoft Entra configuration settings and administrative information across the tenant, but they must not be able to change anything. Which role should you assign?
choices: Security Reader
Reports Reader
Global Reader
Directory Readers
questions.answer: Global Reader
questions.explanation: Global Reader is the read-only counterpart to Global Administrator: it can read settings and administrative information across Microsoft services but cannot take management actions. Security Reader and Reports Reader are limited to security features and reports, and Directory Readers only reads basic directory information.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Litware wants to assign the Exchange Administrator role to an existing security group named Messaging Admins, but the group does not appear when you add the assignment. What should you do FIRST?
choices: Create a new role-assignable group for the role
Turn on role assignment for the existing Messaging Admins group
Change the existing group's membership type to dynamic
Convert the existing group into a Microsoft 365 group
questions.answer: Create a new role-assignable group for the role
questions.explanation: The setting that lets a group receive Microsoft Entra roles can only be chosen when the group is created, so you must create a new role-assignable group. It cannot be enabled later on an existing group, and role-assignable groups cannot use dynamic membership.

questions.stem: Contoso's helpdesk team in Paris must manage user accounts only for employees in France. Employees in other countries must be out of their reach. What should you configure?
choices: A custom role with a country condition, assigned at the tenant scope
A dynamic group of French users, with User Administrator assigned at the group's scope
A separate Microsoft Entra tenant for the French subsidiary
An administrative unit for French users, with User Administrator assigned at that scope
questions.answer: An administrative unit for French users, with User Administrator assigned at that scope
questions.explanation: Administrative units restrict a role assignment to a subset of users, groups or devices, which is the intended way to delegate by region. Microsoft Entra custom roles have no attribute-based conditions, and a group is not a scope that gives User Administrator control over its members' accounts.

questions.stem: Northwind Traders must protect the accounts of its executives so that tenant-scoped administrators, including Global Administrators, cannot change their properties or reset their passwords. Only a small team should be able to manage them. What should you do?
choices: Add the executives to a role-assignable security group
Add the executives to a restricted management administrative unit
Assign the executives the Global Reader role
Create a Conditional Access policy that blocks the admin center for all admins
questions.answer: Add the executives to a restricted management administrative unit
questions.explanation: Objects in a restricted management administrative unit can be changed only by administrators assigned at that unit's scope, even when tenant-wide administrators hold higher roles. Membership in a role-assignable group protects users from lower-privileged admins but still lets a Global Administrator change them.

questions.stem: An administrator created an administrative unit for finance users last month and now needs it to be a restricted management administrative unit. What should the administrator do?
choices: Create a new restricted management unit and move the members into it
Turn on restricted management in the existing unit's properties
Run a Microsoft Graph request to set restricted management on the unit
Remove all members first, then turn on restricted management in the unit
questions.answer: Create a new restricted management unit and move the members into it
questions.explanation: Restricted management can only be set when an administrative unit is created and cannot be changed afterward, so a new unit is required. Editing the property later, through the portal or Graph, is not supported even when the unit is empty.

questions.stem: Adatum wants an administrative unit to keep its membership up to date automatically by using a dynamic membership rule. Which objects can such a rule add to the unit?
choices: Users, groups and devices
Groups only
Users or devices
Users and service principals
questions.answer: Users or devices
questions.explanation: A dynamic membership rule on an administrative unit can target users or devices. Groups can be members of an administrative unit only when added manually, and service principals are not administrative unit members.

questions.stem: An administrative unit contains only the Sales security group. A User Administrator scoped to that unit says that they cannot reset passwords for the people in the Sales group. What is the MOST likely cause?
choices: User Administrator cannot be assigned at an administrative unit scope
Adding a group to an administrative unit does not add the group's members
Password resets work only for members of restricted management administrative units
Only Global Administrators can reset passwords for members of security groups
questions.answer: Adding a group to an administrative unit does not add the group's members
questions.explanation: When a group is added to an administrative unit, the scoped admin can manage the group object, but its members are not in scope unless they are added to the unit themselves. User Administrator is one of the roles that can be scoped to an administrative unit.

questions.topic: Effective permissions for Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Jamal is assigned User Administrator directly and is also a member of a role-assignable group that holds Helpdesk Administrator. Both assignments are at the tenant scope. Which permissions does Jamal have?
choices: Only the permissions of the directly assigned role
Only the permissions that both roles share
Only the permissions of the most recent assignment
The combined permissions of both roles
questions.answer: The combined permissions of both roles
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra role permissions are additive: a user's effective permissions are the union of every role assigned directly or through groups. Direct assignments do not override group assignments, and roles are never intersected.

questions.topic: Effective permissions for Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Ana is eligible for the Security Administrator role in Privileged Identity Management. She signs in to the admin center and finds that she cannot change any security settings. What is the MOST likely reason?
choices: Eligible assignments grant only read access to settings
Security Administrator cannot be managed through PIM
Her account must first be added to an administrative unit
She has not yet activated the eligible assignment
questions.answer: She has not yet activated the eligible assignment
questions.explanation: An eligible assignment grants no permissions until the user activates it, after meeting any MFA, justification or approval requirements. Eligible assignments are not read-only versions of the role, and Security Administrator is fully supported in PIM.

questions.topic: Effective permissions for Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: A Global Administrator at Proseware forgot their password and has no self-service password reset methods registered. You must reset the password by using the least privileged role. Which role should perform the reset?
choices: Authentication Administrator
Privileged Authentication Administrator
Helpdesk Administrator
User Administrator
questions.answer: Privileged Authentication Administrator
questions.explanation: Only Privileged Authentication Administrator (or Global Administrator) can reset passwords and authentication methods for users who hold privileged roles such as Global Administrator. Authentication Administrator, Helpdesk Administrator and User Administrator can only act on non-administrators and a limited set of lower roles.

questions.topic: Effective permissions for Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Bob holds the User Administrator role scoped to the Sales administrative unit. He can update Sales users but receives an error when he tries to reset the password of a Marketing user. Why?
choices: User Administrator cannot reset user passwords
Marketing users are placed in restricted management units by default
His role assignment applies only to objects in the Sales unit
Password resets for other units require the Privileged Role Administrator role
questions.answer: His role assignment applies only to objects in the Sales unit
questions.explanation: A role assigned at an administrative unit scope only applies to the objects in that unit, so a user outside it is out of reach. User Administrator can reset passwords, and administrative units are not restricted management unless created that way.

questions.topic: Effective permissions for Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Jun has Global Reader at the tenant scope and User Administrator scoped to the Seattle administrative unit. Which statement describes what Jun can do?
choices: Read all tenant settings and update only users in the Seattle unit
Update every user, because Global Reader extends write access
Read and update only objects in the Seattle unit
Update every user except those who hold admin roles
questions.answer: Read all tenant settings and update only users in the Seattle unit
questions.explanation: Permissions add up across assignments: Global Reader gives read access across the tenant, and the scoped User Administrator role gives write access only inside the Seattle unit. Global Reader never adds write permissions.

questions.topic: Domains in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
questions.stem: Contoso has added the custom domain contoso.com to Microsoft Entra ID. Which DNS record should the administrator create at the domain registrar to prove ownership of the domain?
choices: A CNAME record that points to the onmicrosoft.com domain
A TXT record that contains the verification value
An SRV record for the sign-in service
A PTR record for the registrar's IP address
questions.answer: A TXT record that contains the verification value
questions.explanation: Domain verification uses a TXT record (or an MX record) containing the value Microsoft provides. CNAME records are used for other services such as autodiscover, not for proving ownership of the domain.

questions.topic: Domains in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
questions.stem: Fabrikam sold a business unit and must remove the domain fabrikamtoys.com from its tenant. The deletion fails because the domain is still in use. What should you do FIRST?
choices: Change the UPNs and email addresses that still use the domain
Delete the TXT verification record for the domain from public DNS first
Convert the domain from managed to federated
Set the initial onmicrosoft.com domain as the tenant's primary domain
questions.answer: Change the UPNs and email addresses that still use the domain
questions.explanation: A custom domain cannot be removed while users, groups or apps still reference it, so those references must be changed to another domain first. Removing the DNS record does not detach objects from the domain in the directory.

questions.topic: Domains in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
questions.stem: Which domain in a Microsoft Entra tenant can never be removed from the tenant?
choices: The current primary custom domain
Any subdomain of a verified domain
A domain verified by an MX record
The initial onmicrosoft.com domain
questions.answer: The initial onmicrosoft.com domain
questions.explanation: The initial onmicrosoft.com domain is created with the tenant and can neither be removed nor renamed. A primary custom domain can be removed after another domain is made primary and its references are cleared.

questions.topic: Domains in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
questions.stem: Tailspin Toys must add and verify several new custom domains. The administrator who does the work must not be able to manage users or other settings. Which role should you assign?
choices: Global Administrator
Hybrid Identity Administrator
Domain Name Administrator
Exchange Administrator
questions.answer: Domain Name Administrator
questions.explanation: Domain Name Administrator can manage domain names in cloud services and on-premises, which is exactly this task. Hybrid Identity Administrator manages sync and federation, and Global Administrator grants far more than needed.

questions.topic: Domains in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
questions.stem: After acquiring Litware, Contoso tries to add litware.com to its own tenant. The admin center reports that the domain is already verified in another Microsoft Entra tenant. What must happen before Contoso can verify the domain?
choices: The domain must be removed from the other tenant
Contoso must federate the domain with the other tenant
Contoso must add the domain as a subdomain of contoso.com
Contoso must set up cross-tenant synchronization first
questions.answer: The domain must be removed from the other tenant
questions.explanation: A domain can be verified in only one Microsoft Entra tenant at a time, so it must be removed from the Litware tenant before Contoso can verify it. Federation and cross-tenant synchronization do not let two tenants share a verified domain.

questions.stem: Adatum configured default company branding with a custom logo and background image. It then added a French browser-language customization that changes only the sign-in page text. What do users whose browser language is French see for the logo and background?
choices: The standard Microsoft logo and background
No logo or background until French versions are uploaded
The logo and background from the default branding
A logo and background chosen from the tenant's country or region
questions.answer: The logo and background from the default branding
questions.explanation: A browser-language customization overrides only the elements you change for that language; any element you leave unchanged falls back to the default branding. The standard Microsoft design appears only where no custom branding exists, and the tenant's country does not select branding elements.

questions.stem: Users at Proseware go to a generic Microsoft sign-in page and see the standard Microsoft design until they type their username. Management wants the company branding to appear as soon as the page loads. What should you do?
choices: Upload a background image with a higher resolution
Have users sign in through a URL that includes the tenant's domain
Convert the company's domain to a federated domain
Enable custom CSS for the default branding
questions.answer: Have users sign in through a URL that includes the tenant's domain
questions.explanation: Microsoft cannot know which tenant's branding to show until it learns the user's domain, either from the username or from a tenant-specific URL or domain hint (for example whr=contoso.com). Image quality and CSS change how branding looks, not when it appears.

questions.stem: Northwind Traders wants a marketing employee to manage the logos, background image and text on the sign-in page. The employee must not get any other administrative permissions. Which role should you assign?
choices: Global Administrator
User Administrator
Application Administrator
Organizational Branding Administrator
questions.answer: Organizational Branding Administrator
questions.explanation: Organizational Branding Administrator manages company branding and nothing more, so it is the least privileged fit. Global Administrator can also change branding but grants control of the whole tenant.

questions.stem: Legal requires every user to see a short notice on the sign-in page reminding them that the system is for authorized use only. Users do not have to accept the notice. What should you configure?
choices: A terms of use in Conditional Access
Username hint text in company branding
A custom banner logo with the notice
Sign-in page text in company branding
questions.answer: Sign-in page text in company branding
questions.explanation: Sign-in page text displays a short message on the sign-in page without requiring any action. A terms of use requires users to accept it, which goes beyond the requirement, and the username hint only replaces the placeholder in the username box.

questions.stem: Contoso does not want users to be shown the Stay signed in? prompt after they sign in. What should you configure?
choices: Turn off security defaults for the tenant
Turn off the option to remain signed in in company branding
Turn on continuous access evaluation
Create a token lifetime policy for the tenant
questions.answer: Turn off the option to remain signed in in company branding
questions.explanation: The Show option to remain signed in setting in company branding controls whether users see the Stay signed in? prompt. Security defaults and continuous access evaluation enforce MFA and token revocation and do not hide the prompt.

questions.topic: Tenant properties and user, group and device settings
questions.stem: Fabrikam set Restrict access to Microsoft Entra admin center to Yes. A non-administrator can still list users by running Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Why?
choices: The setting blocks only the admin center, not Graph or PowerShell
The setting takes 30 days to apply to all users
The user must also be added to an administrative unit before it applies
The setting only applies to guest users and external users in the tenant
questions.answer: The setting blocks only the admin center, not Graph or PowerShell
questions.explanation: Restrict access to Microsoft Entra admin center is not a security boundary: it hides the portal from non-administrators but does not block Microsoft Graph, PowerShell or other clients. To control data access you need other controls, such as Conditional Access.

questions.topic: Tenant properties and user, group and device settings
questions.stem: Security at Tailspin Toys wants to stop employees from creating app registrations on their own. What should you configure?
choices: Disable the Microsoft Graph enterprise application for all users
Turn on restricted management for the app registrations
Set Users can register applications to No
Set Users can create security groups to No
questions.answer: Set Users can register applications to No
questions.explanation: Setting Users can register applications to No removes the default right to register apps; the Application Developer role can then give that right back to chosen developers. Disabling Microsoft Graph would break many apps and does not control app registration.

questions.topic: Tenant properties and user, group and device settings
questions.stem: Adatum must update the privacy statement URL and the technical contact that are shown for its organization. Where are these values configured?
choices: In company branding
In the external collaboration settings
In the tenant properties
In the cross-tenant access settings
questions.answer: In the tenant properties
questions.explanation: The technical contact, privacy contact and privacy statement URL are tenant properties. Company branding controls the sign-in page look, and the external collaboration and cross-tenant settings control guests and other tenants.

questions.topic: Tenant properties and user, group and device settings
questions.stem: Proseware wants only the IT team to create Microsoft 365 groups. Other users must not create them in Outlook, Teams or the portals. Which approach should you use?
choices: Allow only one security group to create Microsoft 365 groups
Configure a Microsoft 365 group naming policy with a blocked words list
Configure a Microsoft 365 group expiration policy for all groups
Set Users can create security groups to No
questions.answer: Allow only one security group to create Microsoft 365 groups
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 group creation is restricted by limiting creation to members of a chosen security group, which applies across Outlook, Teams and the portals. A naming policy only enforces prefixes and blocked words, and the security group setting does not affect Microsoft 365 groups.

questions.topic: Built-in and custom Microsoft Entra roles
questions.stem: Match each administrative task to the least privileged built-in Microsoft Entra role that can perform it.

pairs.item: Create and update Conditional Access policies
Manage role assignments and Privileged Identity Management settings
Manage Microsoft Entra Connect Sync, pass-through authentication and seamless SSO settings
Manage the tenant's authentication methods policy

questions.explanation: Each of these roles is scoped to exactly the listed task, so it is the least privileged choice. Global Administrator could do every task but grants control of the entire tenant, and Application Administrator manages apps rather than any of these tasks.

questions.stem: A company wants its Seattle helpdesk team to reset passwords only for users who work in Seattle. Which TWO actions should you take?
choices: Create an administrative unit that contains the Seattle users
Assign Helpdesk Administrator to the team, scoped to the administrative unit
Assign Helpdesk Administrator to the team at the tenant scope
Create a dynamic group of Seattle users and make the team its owners
Create a custom role that includes a city-based condition
answers: Create an administrative unit that contains the Seattle users
Assign Helpdesk Administrator to the team, scoped to the administrative unit
questions.explanation: An administrative unit holds the Seattle users, and a role assigned at its scope limits the team to those users. A tenant-scoped assignment would cover everyone, and group owners can manage membership but cannot reset members' passwords.

questions.topic: Domains in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
questions.stem: Put the steps in order so that new users at Contoso can sign in with the custom domain contoso.com.
items: Add contoso.com as a custom domain in Microsoft Entra ID
Create the TXT record with the verification value at the DNS host
Verify the domain after the DNS record has propagated
Set contoso.com as the primary domain for new users
questions.explanation: The domain must be added first to get the verification value, which is then published as a TXT record. Verification succeeds only once DNS has propagated, and only a verified domain can become the primary domain used for new users.

questions.topic: Tenant properties and user, group and device settings
questions.stem: Match each requirement to the Microsoft Entra setting that meets it.

pairs.item: Only members of the IT group can join Windows devices to Microsoft Entra ID
pairs.match: Users may join devices to Microsoft Entra, set to Selected

pairs.item: Limit how many devices each user can join or register
pairs.match: Maximum number of devices per user

pairs.item: Stop users from viewing the BitLocker recovery keys of their own devices
pairs.match: Restrict users from recovering the BitLocker keys for their owned devices

pairs.item: Remove inactive Microsoft 365 groups after a set lifetime

questions.explanation: Device join can be limited to selected users or groups, the device limit caps devices per user, and the BitLocker restriction stops users from reading their own recovery keys. A group expiration policy removes Microsoft 365 groups that are not renewed, while a naming policy only controls group names.

questions.stem: A user at Contoso was deleted by mistake 10 days ago. The account must be recovered with its group memberships and licenses intact. What should you do?
choices: Re-create the user with the same UPN
Restore the user from Microsoft Entra Connect
Restore the user from the deleted users list
Open a support request with Microsoft
questions.answer: Restore the user from the deleted users list
questions.explanation: Deleted users stay in a soft-deleted state for 30 days and can be restored with their memberships and attributes. Re-creating the account makes a new object with a new object ID, so access tied to the old account is lost.

questions.stem: An employee at Fabrikam is leaving after a dispute. Security wants the account kept for an investigation but needs to stop the user's access immediately. What should you do?
choices: Block sign-in and revoke the user's sessions
Reset the password and keep the existing sessions open
Remove all of the user's licenses
Delete the user and restore it later
questions.answer: Block sign-in and revoke the user's sessions
questions.explanation: Blocking sign-in stops new authentications, and revoking sessions invalidates refresh tokens so existing sessions must reauthenticate. A password reset alone can leave existing sessions working, and deleting the account is unnecessary for an investigation.

questions.stem: An administrator tries to change the job title of a user in the Microsoft Entra admin center, but the field cannot be edited. The user is synchronized from on-premises Active Directory by Microsoft Entra Connect Sync. What should the administrator do?
choices: Assign the administrator the User Administrator role
Convert the user to a cloud-only account first
Update the job title in company branding
Update the job title in on-premises Active Directory
questions.answer: Update the job title in on-premises Active Directory
questions.explanation: For a synchronized user, on-premises Active Directory is the source of authority, so the attribute must be changed there and synced. Cloud roles cannot edit attributes that sync owns, which is why being a User Administrator does not help.

questions.stem: Which user attribute does a person type, in the form of an email-style name, to sign in to Microsoft Entra ID?
choices: displayName
userPrincipalName
mailNickname
employeeId
questions.answer: userPrincipalName
questions.explanation: The user principal name (UPN) is the sign-in name, formatted like an email address, and it must be unique in the tenant. The display name is only shown in lists, and mailNickname is the email alias.

questions.stem: The HR team at Woodgrove Bank needs one person who can create, update and delete regular user accounts and manage groups. Which role should you assign to follow the principle of least privilege?
choices: User Administrator
Global Administrator
Helpdesk Administrator
Groups Administrator
questions.answer: User Administrator
questions.explanation: User Administrator can create and manage users and groups, which covers both needs without tenant-wide control. Helpdesk Administrator cannot create users and Groups Administrator cannot manage user accounts.

questions.stem: Policy at Litware says that a deleted user account must not be recoverable after an offboarding is approved. What should you do after deleting the user?
choices: Wait 7 days for the deleted object to be purged automatically
Disable the account before deleting it
Remove all of the licenses from the account before you delete it
Permanently delete the user from the deleted users list
questions.answer: Permanently delete the user from the deleted users list
questions.explanation: A deleted user remains restorable for 30 days unless it is permanently deleted from the deleted users list. Disabling the account or removing licenses beforehand does not change how long the deleted object can be restored.

questions.stem: Contoso needs a dynamic group that contains all users whose department attribute is Sales. Which membership rule should you use?
choices: (device.department -eq "Sales")
(user.department -eq "Sales")
(user.department = "Sales")
(user.jobTitle -eq "Sales")
questions.answer: (user.department -eq "Sales")
questions.explanation: Dynamic membership rules use the object.property -operator value syntax, so user.department -eq "Sales" is correct. A plain = sign is not a valid operator, and the rule must reference the user department, not a device property or job title.

questions.stem: Fabrikam plans to use dynamic membership groups for thousands of employees. Which licensing requirement applies?
choices: Microsoft Entra ID P2 for each administrator who writes rules
No license, because the Free edition includes dynamic rules
Microsoft Entra ID P1 for each unique user in a dynamic group
Microsoft Entra ID Governance for each group owner
questions.answer: Microsoft Entra ID P1 for each unique user in a dynamic group
questions.explanation: Dynamic membership needs Microsoft Entra ID P1 (or a license that includes it) for each unique user who is a member of one or more dynamic groups. The Free edition does not include dynamic membership.

questions.stem: An administrator tries to add a contractor to a group named All Engineers, but there is no option to add members manually. The group uses a dynamic user membership rule. What should the administrator do?
choices: Make the contractor an owner of the group
Add the contractor with Microsoft Graph PowerShell
Update the user's attributes or the rule so the user matches
Change the group into a Microsoft 365 group
questions.answer: Update the user's attributes or the rule so the user matches
questions.explanation: Members of a dynamic group are determined only by the rule, so you change the user's attributes or the rule instead of adding the user directly. Owners are not members, and Graph cannot add members to a dynamic group either.

questions.stem: Adatum wants one dynamic group that contains all Windows devices and also the users who sign in to those devices. What should you do?
choices: Create two dynamic groups, one for users and one for devices
Write one rule that combines user and device properties with -and
Create one dynamic device rule that includes registered owners
Create one Microsoft 365 group with a dynamic device rule
questions.answer: Create two dynamic groups, one for users and one for devices
questions.explanation: A dynamic membership rule can contain users or devices, but not both, so two groups are needed. Microsoft 365 groups support only user membership, so they cannot hold devices at all.

questions.stem: A project team at Proseware needs a shared mailbox, calendar, SharePoint site and Teams workspace that are created together. Which type of group should you create?
choices: Security group
Mail-enabled security group
Distribution group
Microsoft 365 group
questions.answer: Microsoft 365 group
questions.explanation: A Microsoft 365 group provisions a shared mailbox, calendar, SharePoint site and can back a team. Security groups only control access, and distribution or mail-enabled security groups only deliver email.

questions.stem: Tailspin Toys configured a group expiration policy with a 180-day lifetime. Six months later, unused security groups are still in the tenant. What is the reason?
choices: The policy runs only after the next 180 days
Expiration policies apply only to Microsoft 365 groups
Security groups are renewed every time they are viewed
The policy requires P2 licenses for each group owner
questions.answer: Expiration policies apply only to Microsoft 365 groups
questions.explanation: Group expiration policies work only on Microsoft 365 groups, not security groups. Microsoft 365 groups that show activity are renewed automatically, but security groups are never in scope.

questions.stem: A Global Administrator at Contoso tries to assign a custom security attribute value to a user but receives an access denied error. Which role should be assigned to the administrator so they can assign attribute values?
choices: Attribute Definition Administrator
Attribute Assignment Administrator
Privileged Role Administrator
User Administrator
questions.answer: Attribute Assignment Administrator
questions.explanation: Global Administrators have no access to custom security attributes by default, so they need an attribute role. Attribute Assignment Administrator assigns values, while Attribute Definition Administrator defines attributes but cannot assign them.

questions.stem: Fabrikam's identity architect must create attribute sets and define new custom security attributes, but must not assign values to users. Which role should you assign?
choices: Attribute Assignment Administrator
Global Administrator
Application Administrator
Attribute Definition Administrator
questions.answer: Attribute Definition Administrator
questions.explanation: Attribute Definition Administrator creates and manages attribute sets and attribute definitions. Attribute Assignment Administrator assigns values, and Global Administrator does not have custom security attribute permissions by default.

questions.stem: Which Microsoft Entra objects can have custom security attribute values assigned to them?
choices: Users and enterprise applications
Groups and devices
Users, groups and devices
Devices and administrative units
questions.answer: Users and enterprise applications
questions.explanation: Custom security attributes can be assigned to users and to enterprise applications (service principals). Groups and devices are not supported as targets.

questions.stem: Adatum no longer needs a custom security attribute named CostCenterCode. The attribute must no longer be assigned to new objects. What should you do?
choices: Delete the attribute definition
Delete the attribute set that holds it
Deactivate the attribute
Rename the attribute and reuse it
questions.answer: Deactivate the attribute
questions.explanation: Custom security attribute definitions and attribute sets cannot be deleted or renamed, but an attribute can be deactivated so that it can no longer be assigned. This keeps existing data intact while stopping new use.

questions.stem: Woodgrove Bank must store a sensitive project code on user accounts. Only a small group of administrators may read or change the value; regular users with directory read access must not see it. What should you use?
choices: Custom security attributes
Directory extension attributes
Exchange custom attributes
Open extensions on the user
questions.answer: Custom security attributes
questions.explanation: Custom security attributes are readable and writable only by users given the attribute roles, which makes them suitable for sensitive data. Directory extensions and Exchange custom attributes can be read by anyone with standard directory read access.

questions.topic: Bulk operations and Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.stem: Litware's HR team sent a spreadsheet of 300 new employees who need cloud-only accounts today. Which method requires the LEAST administrative effort in the Microsoft Entra admin center?
choices: Invite the employees in bulk as guest users
Create each user one by one in the admin center
Use bulk create with the downloaded CSV template
Import the spreadsheet into Microsoft Entra Connect Sync
questions.answer: Use bulk create with the downloaded CSV template
questions.explanation: Bulk create accepts a CSV built from Microsoft's template and creates all the accounts in one operation. Bulk invite creates guests, not employee accounts, and Microsoft Entra Connect Sync synchronizes from Active Directory rather than importing spreadsheets.

questions.topic: Bulk operations and Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.stem: An administrator's provisioning scripts use the retired AzureAD PowerShell module. Which module should the scripts be migrated to?
choices: MSOnline PowerShell
AzureADPreview PowerShell
Exchange Online PowerShell
Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.answer: Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.explanation: The AzureAD and MSOnline modules are retired, and Microsoft Graph PowerShell is their supported replacement for managing Microsoft Entra ID. The preview module is part of the same retired family, and Exchange Online PowerShell does not manage directory users.

questions.topic: Bulk operations and Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.stem: A script will create new users with New-MgUser. Which permission scope should the script request in Connect-MgGraph to follow least privilege?
choices: Directory.ReadWrite.All
User.ReadWrite.All
User.Read.All
User.Read
questions.answer: User.ReadWrite.All
questions.explanation: User.ReadWrite.All allows creating and updating users without broader directory write rights. Directory.ReadWrite.All also works but grants far more, and the read scopes cannot create anything.

questions.topic: Bulk operations and Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.stem: An administrator must assign a Microsoft 365 E5 license to a user with Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Which cmdlet should be used?
choices: Update-MgUser
New-MgGroupMember
Set-MsolUserLicense
Set-MgUserLicense
questions.answer: Set-MgUserLicense
questions.explanation: Set-MgUserLicense adds or removes licenses by SKU ID. Update-MgUser changes properties such as usage location but cannot assign licenses, and Set-MsolUserLicense belongs to the retired MSOnline module.

questions.stem: Employees at Proseware want to read work email on their personal phones. The devices are owned by the employees, who sign in to them with personal accounts. Which device identity should the devices use?
choices: Microsoft Entra joined
Microsoft Entra registered
Microsoft Entra hybrid joined
On-premises domain joined
questions.answer: Microsoft Entra registered
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra registration is designed for personal (BYOD) devices where the user keeps a personal sign-in and adds a work account. Microsoft Entra join is for organization-owned devices that users sign in to with their work accounts.

questions.stem: The support team at Contoso must have local administrator rights on every Microsoft Entra joined Windows device with the LEAST administrative effort. What should you do?
choices: Add the team to the local Administrators group on each device by hand
Assign the team the Cloud Device Administrator role at tenant scope
Assign the Microsoft Entra Joined Device Local Administrator role
Make the team the registered owners of each device
questions.answer: Assign the Microsoft Entra Joined Device Local Administrator role
questions.explanation: Members of the Microsoft Entra Joined Device Local Administrator role are added to the local Administrators group on all Microsoft Entra joined devices. Cloud Device Administrator manages device objects in the directory but does not grant local admin rights.

questions.stem: Fabrikam must require multifactor authentication whenever users join or register a device in Microsoft Entra ID. Which approach does Microsoft recommend?
choices: A Conditional Access policy for the register or join devices user action
The device setting that requires MFA to register or join devices
A per-user MFA setting for every user who enrolls devices
Security defaults combined with a device limit of five
questions.answer: A Conditional Access policy for the register or join devices user action
questions.explanation: Microsoft recommends a Conditional Access policy that targets the register or join devices user action, and the device setting that requires MFA should be left at No when you use it. Per-user MFA is a legacy method and not tied to device registration.

questions.stem: A technician needs to check, from a Windows device, whether the device is Microsoft Entra joined or hybrid joined. Which command should the technician run?
choices: gpresult /r
dsregcmd /status
whoami /all
ipconfig /all
questions.answer: dsregcmd /status
questions.explanation: dsregcmd /status shows the device's join state, such as AzureAdJoined and DomainJoined, and its Primary Refresh Token status. gpresult shows Group Policy results and does not report Microsoft Entra join state.

questions.stem: Adatum has hundreds of device objects that have not signed in for six months. You must clean them up with the LEAST risk of disrupting users. What should you do?
choices: Disable the stale devices, then delete them after a grace period
Delete all of the stale devices immediately
Remove the licenses from the devices' registered owners and users
Rotate the BitLocker recovery keys stored for each of the stale devices
questions.answer: Disable the stale devices, then delete them after a grace period
questions.explanation: Disabling first lets you re-enable any device that turns out to be in use before you delete it. Immediate deletion cannot be undone for devices and can remove BitLocker keys stored with the device object.

questions.stem: An administrator at Northwind Traders tries to assign a Microsoft 365 license directly to a new cloud user and receives an error. The user's other properties are complete. What should the administrator set?
choices: The user's manager attribute
The user's preferred language
The user's usage location
The user's employee type
questions.answer: The user's usage location
questions.explanation: A usage location is required before a license can be assigned directly to a user, because some services are not available in every country. The other attributes are optional and do not affect licensing.

questions.stem: Contoso wants every member of the Sales department to receive Microsoft 365 E3 automatically when HR sets their department, and lose it when they leave the department. Which solution requires the LEAST administrative effort?
choices: Run a weekly script that assigns licenses with PowerShell
Assign the license directly to each Sales user
Assign the license to an administrative unit for Sales
Assign the license to a dynamic group based on department
questions.answer: Assign the license to a dynamic group based on department
questions.explanation: Group-based licensing on a dynamic group adds and removes licenses automatically as users match or stop matching the rule. Licenses cannot be assigned to administrative units, and scripts or direct assignment need ongoing manual work.

questions.stem: A user at Fabrikam inherits a Visio license from the Design group. The user no longer needs Visio, but the remove option is unavailable on the user's license page. What should you do?
choices: Remove the license directly from the user
Disable the Visio service plan for the user
Delete and re-create the user's account
Remove the user from the Design group
questions.answer: Remove the user from the Design group
questions.explanation: A license inherited from a group cannot be removed from the user directly; it is removed when the user leaves the group or the group's assignment changes. Only directly assigned licenses can be removed on the user.

questions.stem: Litware needs an administrator who can assign licenses to users and to groups, without the right to create or delete users. Which role follows the principle of least privilege?
choices: User Administrator
License Administrator
Billing Administrator
Groups Administrator
questions.answer: License Administrator
questions.explanation: License Administrator manages license assignments for users and group-based licensing, and can set usage location, without managing user accounts. User Administrator can also assign licenses but adds full user management, and Billing Administrator handles purchases.

questions.stem: Fabrikam wants new marketing employees added to the Marketing security group automatically as soon as HR sets their department to Marketing. Which TWO actions should you take?
choices: Set the group's membership type to Dynamic User
Add the rule (user.department -eq "Marketing")
Set the group's membership type to Assigned
Set the group's membership type to Dynamic Device
Make the HR manager an owner of the group
Apply a group expiration policy to the group
answers: Set the group's membership type to Dynamic User
questions.explanation: A Dynamic User group with a department rule adds and removes users automatically as the attribute changes. Assigned membership needs manual changes, and a Dynamic Device group cannot contain users.

questions.topic: Bulk operations and Microsoft Graph PowerShell
questions.stem: Put the steps in order to create and license new users with Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
items: Install the Microsoft Graph PowerShell module
Sign in with Connect-MgGraph and the required scopes
Set each account's usage location with Update-MgUser
questions.explanation: The module must be installed before you connect, and you must connect before you can create users. A user needs a usage location before a license can be assigned, so Set-MgUserLicense comes last.

questions.stem: Match each device scenario to the device identity it should use.

pairs.item: Employee-owned phone that the user signs in to with a personal account
New company laptop for a cloud-only organization with no Active Directory
Existing domain-joined desktop that must also satisfy device-based Conditional Access
Desktop managed only by on-premises Group Policy that has no identity in Microsoft Entra ID

questions.explanation: Personal devices are registered, cloud-only corporate devices are joined, and devices already joined to on-premises Active Directory become hybrid joined. A computer that is only domain joined has no device identity in Microsoft Entra ID, so device-based Conditional Access cannot evaluate it.

questions.stem: Group-based licensing at Contoso shows an error state for several members of the E5 Users group. Which TWO conditions could cause the errors?
choices: The tenant has no remaining licenses for the product
Two assigned products contain service plans that conflict
The group is a security group rather than a Microsoft 365 group
The members are synchronized from on-premises Active Directory
The group uses dynamic membership
The members hold the User Administrator role
answers: The tenant has no remaining licenses for the product
Two assigned products contain service plans that conflict
questions.explanation: Running out of licenses and conflicting service plans are common group-based licensing errors. Security groups, synchronized users and dynamic groups are all supported, and directory roles do not affect license assignment.
